title: Audit log
description: Append-only record of everything done with this tool. Entries are chained and signed (HMAC, key kept in the vault), so edits or deletions are detected. Signed checkpoints kept outside the database also detect entries removed at the end.
anchorHint: Paste a checkpoint kept outside Steward – from the SIEM (log line "audit checkpoint"), a checkpoint e-mail or a downloaded checkpoint file. Verification fails when the log is shorter than the checkpoint or differs from it.

anchoring.title: Anchoring outside the database
anchoring.hint: Every {{minutes}} minutes (when there are new entries), after each verification and before each export, Steward signs a checkpoint with this installation's key. It is logged for your SIEM, written to the data folder and can be e-mailed to auditors – with it, removing entries no longer goes unnoticed.
anchoring.emailsHint: Auditors or a write-once mailbox; uses the e-mail settings of notifications
